name: tmux_create_session
description: Create a new tmux session. Optionally start it with a command and/or in a specific directory.

command.description: Command to run immediately in the session (optional)

name: tmux_send_command
description: Send text input to a tmux session pane. By default sends Enter after the text. Use special_key for control sequences like C-c or Escape.

text.description: Text to send to the pane

special_key.description: Special key to send instead of Enter after text (e.g., 'C-c', 'Escape', 'Tab'). If set without text, sends just the key.

no_enter.description: If true, do not send Enter after the text (default: false)

name: tmux_read_output
description: Read the current visible output from a tmux session pane. Returns the last N lines (default 50).

lines.description: Number of lines to capture from the end (default: 50)

full.description: If true, capture the entire scrollback buffer

name: tmux_list_sessions
description: List all tmux sessions with their status, window count, and creation time.

name: tmux_kill_session
description: Kill (destroy) a tmux session by name.

name: tmux_wait_for_text
description: Wait for specific text to appear in a tmux pane output. Polls at regular intervals until the text is found or timeout is reached.

regex.description: If true, treat pattern as a regex (default: false, uses fixed string match)
